integrity: Mathematical argument and finite-field checks are provided. Finite computations do not independently prove the all-size claim. No independent external audit or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Complex-valued operators on Z_m by Z_n for integer side lengths m,n >= 5; exact kernel and invertibility only; no finite-boundary boards, no conditioning bound. A classical Conway-Jones trigonometric classification is used as a cited theorem. Older specialist spectra may have equivalent cases.
title: Exact arithmetic nullity of periodic knight-move Fourier convolution
